best_plan.name: p5
best_plan.rationale: p5 wins because it improves ranking quality the most while keeping cost in the same range as the cheaper plans. Its key improvement is to collapse duplicate reviews before semantic scoring, so the movie score is based more nearly on one score per unique review instead of overweighting repeats. That raised quality above p1 and p2, and although p5 is a bit more expensive and slower than p2, the gain in ranking accuracy is meaningful while the added dollar cost is small.

cost_model_explanation: The cost model showed that sem_map is overwhelmingly the dominant cost and latency driver; filter, project, and groupby were essentially free by comparison. That guided the search toward plans that changed record counts before sem_map and used the cheaper Gemini Flash-Lite model rather than a stronger but much more expensive model. Deduplicating reviews before scoring improved quality enough to justify a small extra cost, while a larger-model alternative had a much worse estimated cost trade-off.

plan_codes.p1:
pipeline = PhysicalPipeline(plan_name, "Reviews.csv", load_data("Reviews.csv"))
pipeline.filter(lambda row: row.get("reviewText") is not None and str(row.get("reviewText")).strip() != "")
pipeline.sem_map(
    [{
        "name": "review_score",
        "type": int,
        "description": "Rate the sentiment of this movie review from 1 to 5, where 1 is very negative, 2 is negative, 3 is mixed or neutral, 4 is positive, and 5 is very positive."
    }],
    model=pz.Model.GOOGLE_GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_LITE,
    depends_on=["reviewText"]
)
pipeline.project(["idx", "review_score"])
pipeline.groupby(["idx"], ["average"], ["review_score"])
pipeline.project(["idx", "average(review_score)"])
pipeline

plan_codes.p5:
pipeline = PhysicalPipeline(plan_name, "Reviews.csv", load_data("Reviews.csv"))
pipeline.filter(lambda row: row.get("reviewText") is not None and str(row.get("reviewText")).strip() != "")
pipeline.project(["idx", "reviewId", "reviewText"])
pipeline.groupby(["idx", "reviewId", "reviewText"], ["count"], ["reviewId"])
pipeline.project(["idx", "reviewId", "reviewText"])
pipeline.sem_map(
    [{
        "name": "review_score",
        "type": int,
        "description": "Read this critic review and assign exactly one integer movie-review score from 1 to 5. 1 means very negative, 2 negative, 3 mixed or neutral, 4 positive, and 5 very positive. Infer the critic's overall judgment, including sarcasm and mixed praise. Return just the score."
    }],
    model=pz.Model.GOOGLE_GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_LITE,
    depends_on=["reviewText"]
)
pipeline.project(["idx", "review_score"])
pipeline.groupby(["idx"], ["average"], ["review_score"])
pipeline.project(["idx", "average(review_score)"])
pipeline
